name: HomeCoin
oneLiner: HOME is HomeCoin's dollar stablecoin backed by U.S. home-loan liens and property receivables, with foreclosure as the ultimate recovery path.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

collateral: U.S. home-loan liens and property-backed receivables originated through the HomeCoin/Bacon lending process
pegMechanism: HOME is minted and redeemed 1:1 for USDC through Bacon Protocol's Pan contract subject to Pan liquidity. The mortgage-lien portfolio is collateral/backstop exposure rather than a direct user redemption asset.

notices.title: Illiquid RWA collateral
notices.message: HomeCoin collateral is property-backed receivables, so the fallback is not comparable to liquid fiat or Treasury redemption capacity.

mintAuthority.summary: HOME token (0xb8919522331c59f5c16bdfaa6a121a6e03a91f62) is an EIP-1967 proxy. The ProxyAdmin (0x5729890f78c07bc2d1c09345001f6c1f0c9d7d6f) is owned by a 5-signer legacy Gnosis MultiSigWallet (0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486, threshold 3-of-5). Minting occurs only through Bacon Protocol Pan contracts when borrowers draw lien-backed loans. BACON governance controls Pan additions.

controls.label: Bacon Protocol Pan lending/mint contract
controls.capDescription: HOME supply expands only as new overcollateralized home loans are originated through a Pan; minting is tied to lien-backed loan creation rather than free issuer mint.
controls.evidence: HOME token (0xb8919522331c59f5c16bdfaa6a121a6e03a91f62) is a proxy (EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x366049d336e73cfaf39c6a933780ca4c96ea084c, 24022 bytes); owner() reverts on the proxy — minting is contract-controlled via Pan loan origination.

controls.label: HomeCoin ProxyAdmin owner (legacy Gnosis MultiSigWallet)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203: HOME token EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x5729890f78c07bc2d1c09345001f6c1f0c9d7d6f (ProxyAdmin, verified via Blockscout). ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486. getOwners() on that address returns 5 EOA addresses; storage slot 4 = 3 (required/threshold); storage slot 3 = 5 (ownerCount). Contract is 342 bytes — classic Gnosis MultiSigWallet (pre-Safe, no module system).
